title: City
description: A build location: a board location plus its region and its ordered industry slots. The two farm breweries use this same shape with a single brewery-only slot.

region.description: Banner colour group. Governs which seat counts put this city's cards in the deck.

items.description: The industries this printed space accepts.

slots.description: Ordered build spaces. The index is referenced by built-tile.slot-index and by every move id, so the order is frozen.
